commuted on such grounds and in such mamer as may be sprecified in the

for the same period more than one of the allowances provided for in this Act.
(2) Where an insured person is entitled to more than one allowaace under

(3) Where an insured person is entitled to an allowance under this Act arrd
to a disablement peqsion under the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security
Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ordinance No. X of 1965) he shall be given the higher
of the two.
